description: We are AstroPioneers, a team of young innovators passionate about space exploration and scientific discovery. Through our INDOSPACE MISSION, we aim to make asteroid exploration exciting and accessible. Inspired by NASA's OSIRIS-REx mission to Bennu, we have created a physical prototype and an interactive space simulation game featuring spacecraft launch, space navigation and asteroid landing. Our mission is to turn curiosity into innovation and inspire everyone to explore beyond Earth.
summary: Indospace Mission is an asteroid exploration project that combines a physical spacecraft and rover prototype with an interactive digital space simulation game. Inspired by NASA's OSIRIS-REx mission to asteroid Bennu, the project explores how spacecraft can travel towards an asteroid, simulate landing and conduct robotic exploration. The physical model includes a cardboard asteroid structure, miniature spacecraft and a six-wheel rover. Its digital component allows players to experience a simulated spacecraft launch from Earth, navigate through space, perform a simulated asteroid landing and explore the asteroid through an interactive gaming experience. The project uses NASA-reported information about asteroid 101955 Bennu, including its approximate diameter, type, rotation period, orbital period and shape, as a scientific reference for the model. Indospace Mission aims to make asteroid exploration engaging and accessible through hands-on model-making, scientific research and interactive learning.
details:
Indospace Mission is a miniature asteroid exploration project that combines scientific research, physical prototyping and interactive digital simulation.

The mission is designed around exploring an asteroid using a spacecraft and a robotic rover. The physical prototype consists of a cardboard asteroid structure, a miniature spacecraft, a six-wheel rover and a space exploration display.

The scientific foundation of the project is asteroid 101955 Bennu, using NASA-reported information as a reference. The team studied Bennu's approximate diameter of 492 metres, B-type carbon-rich classification, rotation period of approximately 4.3 hours, orbital period of approximately 1.2 Earth years and spinning-top-like shape.

The digital innovation is an interactive space mission simulation game. Players can simulate a spacecraft launch from Earth, navigate through space towards an asteroid, experience a simulated spacecraft landing and explore the asteroid through an interactive gaming experience.

The project draws inspiration from NASA's OSIRIS-REx mission, which launched in 2016, arrived at Bennu in 2018, collected asteroid material in 2020 and delivered the sample to Earth in 2023.

By combining a physical model with a digital simulation, Indospace Mission makes asteroid exploration more engaging and accessible. It encourages students to understand asteroid science, spacecraft missions, robotic exploration and the importance of real-world space research.

The project is an educational miniature model and interactive simulation, not an operational spacecraft or actual asteroid landing system.
